Discover security vulnerabilities in source code.

When called without a subcommand, runs a quick scan (classifier only).

  cm find <path>             Quick scan (May have false positives. Use 'cm verify' to triage.)

Use 'cm verify <finding-id>' to verify a specific finding from a previous scan.

Usage:
  cm find [command]
Flags:
  -c, --context <text>           Additional context to guide the scan agent
      --deep                     Exhaustive file-by-file deep scan of all discovered source files
      --deep-workers int         Number of concurrent workers for deep scan (1 to 16, default: 8) (default 8)
      --diff string[="HEAD"]     Scan modified files and 1-hop impacted callers from git diff (optional target ref, e.g. origin/main)
      --diff-depth int           Impact resolution depth for --diff (default: 1-hop) (default 1)
      --diff-max-neighbors int   Maximum number of 1-hop neighbor files to inspect (default: 10) (default 10)
      --diff-workers int         Number of concurrent workers for --diff scan (1 to 16, default: 4) (default 4)
      --fail-on string           Comma-separated severities that cause cm find to exit with code 1 in CI (CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM,LOW) (default "CRITICAL,HIGH")
      --fail-on-truncation       Fail with a non-zero exit code if 1-hop impact expansion exceeds the candidate cluster cap
      --format string            Output format: table, json, sarif (default "table")
  -h, --help                     help for find
      --model string             LLM model to use (default "cm-default-model")
      --output string            Write scan report to file instead of stdout
      --staged                   When using --diff, scope diff to staged changes only (git diff --cached)
      --unrestricted             Disable filesystem sandbox (allow agent to access any path)
  -y, --yes                      Skip all confirmation prompts (commands and file writes)

Use "cm find [command] --help" for more information about a command.
